turbo_Entity.severityBreakdown.CRITICAL.justification: Both fields refer to the count of critical severity vulnerabilities.

turbo_Entity.severityBreakdown.MAJOR.justification: Major severity breakdowns are conceptually similar to high severity vulnerabilities.

turbo_Entity.severityBreakdown.MINOR.justification: Minor severity breakdowns are conceptually similar to low severity vulnerabilities.

turbo_Entity.severityBreakdown.NORMAL.justification: Normal severity breakdowns are conceptually similar to medium severity vulnerabilities.
